description:
Configure Jitsi Meet so that the in-meeting toolbar remains permanently visible (disabling the auto-hide feature). 

1. Edit the interface configuration override file at `/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/custom-interface_config.js` to set `TOOLBAR_ALWAYS_VISIBLE` to `true`.
2. Restart the Jitsi Meet web container (project in `/home/ga/jitsi/`) to apply the changes.
3. Verify the fix by joining a meeting (e.g., room 'SilverConnectTest') and confirming the toolbar stays visible after 10 seconds of inactivity.
4. Save a screenshot of the meeting with the visible toolbar to `/home/ga/Documents/persistent_toolbar.png`.
